description: This file is a header (.h) file that declares constants, functions, and data related to applying system defaults and partner information within a software project. It provides function prototypes for retrieving and setting system configuration, parsing JSON files, and initializing system components.

methods.name: get_PartnerID
methods.description: Retrieves the partner ID and stores it in the provided buffer.

methods.name: parse_command_line
methods.description: Parses command line arguments to configure system settings.

methods.name: set_syscfg_partner_values
methods.description: Sets partner-related configuration values based on provided parameters.

methods.name: compare_partner_json_param
methods.description: Compares partner JSON parameters for validation or synchronization.

methods.name: apply_partnerId_default_values
methods.description: Applies default values associated with the partner ID.

methods.name: json_file_parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON file from the specified path.

methods.name: init_bootstrap_json
methods.description: Initializes bootstrap JSON configuration with partner data.

methods.name: getPartnerIdWithRetry
methods.description: Retrieves the partner ID with retry logic.

methods.name: set_psm_record
methods.description: Sets a PSM record with a specified name and value.
